firstLines: I'm writing to apply for the Marketing Specialist position on your member engagement team. For the past
three years I have planned and reported on email and social campaigns in health care and retail, and I'd
like to bring that work to a credit union that cares about its members.
At Kettlewell Health Partners I send 10 to 12 patient email campaigns a month. When I started, the open
rate averaged 24%. After I cleaned up the lists and tested shorter subject lines, it settled around 31%. I
also built the monthly report on appointment requests that our director now takes into budget meetings.
Your posting mentions a new member onboarding series. I've built welcome sequences before and I
know how much the first three emails matter. I'd be glad to share what worked for us and hear what your
Thank you for your time. I look forward to talking with you.
